cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
PR #6875 added code in `tfjs-layers/src/layers/preprocessing/center_crop.ts`

```js
import {resizeBilinear} from '@tensorflow/tfjs-core/ops/image/resize_bilinear';
import {cropAndResize} from '@tensorflow/tfjs-core/ops/image/crop_and_resize';
```

how is this import supposed to be resolved?  
i cannot get a clean build of `tfjs` due to this. and it goes against all other import syntax used.

```log
src/tfjs-layers/src/layers/preprocessing/center_crop.ts:13:30 - error TS2307: Cannot find module '@tensorflow/tfjs-core/ops/image/resize_bilinear' or its corresponding type declarations.
```

cc @AdamLang96 @mattsoulanille

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix incorrect import path in center crop layer
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement: Fix incorrect import path in center crop layer `center_crop.ts` imported some dependencies from `@tensorflow/tfjs-core/ops/...`. This works in Bazel (not completely sure why), but is not standard and should be avoided. Fixes #6944 To see the logs from the Cloud Build CI, please join either our [discussion](https://groups.google.com/a/tensorflow.org/forum/#!forum/tfjs) or [announcement](https://groups.google.com/a/tensorflow.org/forum/#!forum/tfjs-announce) mailing list. - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/tensorflow/tfjs/6946)
